relationships.subject: ACC PV neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibiting PV neurons in ACC improved social preference disorders in adult mice that experienced inflammatory pain during childhood.

relationships.subject: ACC SST neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibiting SST neurons in ACC improved social novelty disorders in adult mice that experienced BWT in childhood.

key_findings: Neonatal CFA inflammatory pain increases ACC PV neuron number and causes adult social preference deficits, rescued by chemogenetic/optogenetic inhibition of ACC PV neurons.
Childhood (and adult) whisker trimming causes social novelty deficits linked to increased ACC SST neurons; inhibiting ACC SST neurons rescues them.
